name: io.github.IamSAL/jira-easy-mcp
description: Self-hosted Jira Server/Data Center 7-10 for AI agents with username + password. 42 tools.

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Jira Server/Data Center URL, including any context path (e.g. https://jira.example.com/jira)

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Jira username (optional if stored in the OS keychain under JiraMCP)

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Jira password (optional if stored in the OS keychain under JiraMCP)

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_PROJECTS_FILTER
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated project keys the agent may access

environmentVariables.name: JIRA_SSL_VERIFY
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to skip TLS verification (prefer NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS)
